item.title: 1.21.22 (Beta)
item.description:
Drawing Beta Bugfixes

  • Fixed zoom controls being blocked by "Add Source" button during flashcard practice on handwritten notes

  • Fixed missing star icon for pinning handwritten documents to the sidebar

  • Fixed exported images not including drawn annotations

  • Fixed overlapping buttons at bottom of screen when drawing on images on iPhone

  • Fixed occlusion boxes not properly scrolling into view during practice sessions

  • Fixed occlusion boxes becoming too dark to see when resizing in dark mode

  • Fixed issue where "Type in answer" option couldn't be enabled for image occlusion cards created from PDF or tape occlusions

  • Fixed shape recognition incorrectly triggering triangles or hexagons when drawing ovals

  • Fixed inability to export or print only the editor document attached to a drawing

  • Fixed PDF and SVG exports not retaining the document's original name

  • Fixed issue where practicing one image occlusion card from a PDF would hide remaining cards behind the "time to take a break" screen

  • Fixed "Show boxes in editor" setting label to display "in Reader" when opened in PDF reader

  • Fixed missing image in image occlusion tooltip

  • Fixed PDF area highlight color not updating for existing highlights until after adding a new highlight

  • Removed duplicate menu options from area highlight tool's context menu in PDF reader

  • Fixed PDF title being truncated in the title editing menu even when using arrow keys to navigate

item.title: 1.21.21 (Beta)
item.description:
Bugfixes

  • Audio Recorder: Fixed audio recorder issues.

  • AI Tools: Fixed split-screen opening unexpectedly after AI card creation.

  • AI Tools: Fixed various issues with AI features including chat, prompts, and card generation.

  • Panes: Fixed regression where panes weren’t splitting vertically.

Drawing Beta

  • Increased chevron size in arrows and rounded arrow endpoints to match pen stroke style

  • Fixed element selection accuracy - clicks now properly select intended targets instead of nearby elements

  • Enabled arrow key movement of selected elements in 1px increments (Select mode only)

  • Fixed shapes flipping, distorting, or changing size when selecting and moving

  • Fixed pen squiggle distortion when duplicating and pasting

  • Made it easier to select inside existing items when using pen draw tool

  • Improved ability to move squiggle lines

  • Fixed pen stroke lag behind cursor

  • Color wheel now updates when selecting colors from bottom palette

  • Enabled drag functionality to change colors in selection bar

  • Increased highlighter dot size for better visibility

  • Fixed highlighter dots disappearing when clicked

  • Removed background overlay behind color wheel for faster color selection

  • Added Shift+Drag feature to select multiple elements while keeping existing selection

  • Fixed selection of highlighted elements with small container sizes

  • Element arrangement (forward/backward) now updates immediately

  • Fixed elements disappearing or being deleted when moved

  • Fixed Undo function occasionally reversing two steps and distorting scaled elements

  • Fixed arrow thickness changes not applying

  • Adjusted hold-to-form-shapes feature to reduce interference with handwritten notes

  • Fixed laggy drawing on pictures on iPad

  • Fixed paste functionality after cutting image elements on iPad

  • Enabled exit from custom color selection with Apple Pencil Pro in selection mode

  • Added Apple Pencil double-tap support for switching between draw tools and eraser

  • Fixed double-tapping shapes with Apple Pencil to properly start text mode

  • Fixed sources menu missing when PDF reader is open

  • Increased maximum zoom level for PDFs

  • PDF zoom level now retained when switching between tabs

  • Improved PDF scroll thumbnail visibility with better contrast

  • Fixed PDF page number being cut off by undo/redo buttons

  • Fixed keyboard shortcut M for merging image occlusions

  • Removed inactive scrollbar appearing next to some images in queue

  • Fixed crop button to properly exit crop mode when clicked again

  • Fixed mobile config popup appearance

  • Fixed inability to close drawing menus when sidebar is opened

  • Added tooltips for all toolbar items

  • Fixed occlusion toolbar overflow on phones

  • Enabled scrolling on pen menu bar on phones

  • Fixed icons being cut off after expanding draw option on phone

  • Increased toolbar icon sizes for iPads and desktop monitors

  • Adjusted quick options component sizing for narrow PDF panes

  • Added text alignment center and right options in vertical toolbar mode

  • Improved toolbar layout when PDF width is too small

  • Fixed drag to re-order functionality in Configure Toolbar menu

  • Moved Pen tool before Highlight Pen in toolbar

  • Fixed popup menu getting stuck open

  • Fixed floating menu not activating correctly

  • Fixed editing existing front/back card labels

  • Fixed letter sizing issues

  • Updated paste and bluetooth icons

item.title: 1.21.20 (Beta)
item.description:
Bugfixes

  • Drawing Canvas: Fixed various issues and improved overall polish.

  • Drawing Canvas: Toolbar spacing upgrades.

  • Android App: Fixed the cursor color being weird for some users.

  • Editor: Fixed issue causing the app to freeze when using Cmd+F search and collapsing a Rem.

  • Editor: Fixed issue when deleting Rem.

  • MCAT: Fixed daily emails link not working.

  • YouTube Annotator: Potential fix for YouTube 153 errors on desktop.

item.title: 1.21.19 (Beta)
item.description:
Bugfixes

  • Fix issues with built in tabs

  • Fix a crash from the old tabs plugin

  • Fix Advanced Configuration only showing on column toolbar

Drawing Beta:

  • Add page rotation / landscape pages to handwritten documents

  • You can now toggle the view of the occlusion boxes in the editor

  • Add "hide one, test others "

  • Add explanatory tooltips

  • Fix image occlusion tape doesn't reveal answer in queue in the handwritten document

  • Fix renaming canvases

  • Fix sticky note font is weird on iPad

  • Fix text in sequence

  • Fix "Set Occlusion Area" not working in Infinite Canvas

  • Lots of other smaller fixes

item.title: 1.21.18 (Beta)
item.description:
Bug Fixes

  • Editor: Fixed hierarchy selection shortcut not working for gray text.

  • MCAT: Fixed quiz questions not loading.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed adding tags from the PDF header more menu.

  • Mobile: Closed the keyboard when the sidebar is opened in floating mode.

Bugfixes

  • Fix uneditable inline drawings on phones

  • Fix various issues with pasting and manipulating area highlights

  • Fix issues if you open image occlusion too fast

  • Improved writing window UI

  • Fix "Z' shortcut" not working

  • Highlight selection menu rendering outside the current view

  • Take a note menu keeps popping up even when dismissed

  • Cleanup tape jaggedness more

  • Fix Shift+Click no longer alows selecting multiple occlusion boxes

  • Pressing Space while being zoomed into an image in queue doesn't show the answer

  • Area highlight gets stuck in "too small" mode on click, can't select others

  • Mobile UI add back hiding on scroll for PDFs

  • Print PDFs with drawing items on them

Drawing Alpha

  • Squiggles should feel much smoother now

  • New quiz generation UI

  • Let you hold space bar to pan

  • Add a go-to-parent-folder button

  • Add dark mode support for inline drawings

  • Let you use 1,2,3,4 etc. keyboard shortcuts to switch tools

  • Add option to convert to text and still keep the image

  • Add more footer space, fix "New Page" getting overlapped

  • Default to shape on desktop

  • Fix dark mode issues

  • Default to pen only on tablet

  • Other improvements and fixes


Bugfixes

  • Simple Tables: Added delete table option to the first row toolbar.

  • Tablet Interface: Added new rem and add indented rem buttons.

  • Help Center: Fixed blank screen appearing after closing the help center popup.

  • Simple Tables: Fixed card generation toggle not working properly.

  • Simple Tables: Fixed column type sorting in table selection.

  • Simple Tables: Fixed image display issues in table cells.

Drawing Alpha:

  • Added printing, export as PDF, and export as image.

  • Added dark mode rendering.

  • You can now customize the pen stroke size (click on the stroke size selector to open the popup).

  • You can now draw with dashed and dotted lines (click on the pen size selector to open the popup).

  • If you record audio alongside a document, you can now select items and press "Play audio" from the corresponding timestamp.

  • You can now edit the title for infinite canvas documents.

  • Added top bar for navigation on mobile.

  • You can now click on buttons on the toolbar to hide their floating menu.

  • Added ability to copy selection as image.

  • Improved drag to add page feature to activate more easily.

  • Improved right click menu.

  • Improved snap to select pen tool UI.

  • Removed opacity option on pen tool.

  • Fixed go back to content navigation functionality.

  • Fixed writing window buttons not working properly on infinite canvases.

  • Other polish and bugfixes.

Drawing Alpha

  • Fix images not rendering properly

  • You can now add new blank pages to PDFs

  • Infinite canvases can now zoom in and out further

  • Move PDF title to the top bar

  • Fix image occlusion label sizes

  • Fix toolbar positioning and opening issues

  • Fix issues moving arrows

  • Allow arrows to go inside images

  • Fix various image occlusion bugs

  • Maintain zoom after crop

  • More misc fixes

Bugfixes

  • Fix cramped labels on the Omnibar

Drawing Alpha:

  • More drag / pan optimizations, pen optimizations and overall optimizations

  • Add "snap to shape" tool

  • Make it easier to select and add text in shapes

  • Improve inline drawing display

  • Improve bulk selection

  • Improved text input

  • Improved cursors

  • Easier PDF text selection setting switches and highlight selection

  • Make highlight straight on hold

  • Add /handwritten notes command to add drawings in the editor

  • Default to pan on mobile

  • More toolbar improvements

  • Keyboard shortcuts are now changeable

  • Fix flipping pen squiggles

  • Many other misc improvements

Bugfixes

  • Fix "Quiz Explanation" acting up in some KBs

  • Fix jittery text selection in text reader

  • Fix upload popup not closing sometimes
